label: judge: compete
result: I wrote `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/spec/v2-upgrades/compete.md`. It merges the three designers' 36 proposals into 25 upgrades, C1–C25, and all four required parts are in it. The scorecard has 33 rows, covering all of §3.7.1 and their shipped rules, plus contest timing. v2 was only at parity (or below) on 17 of them, and each of those verdicts names the upgrade that fixes it. The upgrades are: a Debrief that prices every miss by misconception and by the places it cost, with Fix it on same-trap twins; a Rematch two days later with a Won back score; a pace bonus measured against each question's own time budget (easy 1:05, medium 1:35, hard 2:06); the Season Final feeding the last week before the test, plus a printable test-day card; par and an Over par board, so any level has a board it can top; par rows and field-line fallbacks, so no board is ever empty (the dev DB has 7 learners); a lobby forecast with a warm-up; races against any run, your best, par or SAT pace, where the shared link becomes the race; rivals and Following; movement, the gap and the cheapest step past the next row; ratings by domain and skill; three new kinds (Trap of the week with a Trap Index, Rush, and a Word Sprint that makes contests subject-aware); "verify, don't void", where a flagged right answer is re-checked on a strict twin instead of zeroed; ties decided by points only, never by time; 1.5×/2× timing that is never shown publicly; a class streak with nudges and a fair Classes board; contests built from open mistakes, whose results assign a repair; a board grid view; records and season recaps; a history that works as a to-do list and replaces the picker; badges with a Go button; one tap to question 1, with keys; and a challenge-streak make-up. Wherever a sibling file already had the piece, these reuse it instead of re-specifying it: the ratings and time budgets from practice.md, the miss causes, twin sheet and final stretch from today.md, and the habits, pace, Climb, inbox and reminders from shell-me.md. The spec overrides quote 39 places in §3.7 with their replacements, including a new build order that moves rating into step 1. A separate table lists the changes needed in Part 2 and in the sibling files. One of those corrects Today T15, whose copy still says "ranked by right answers, then time". The Rejected list gives a reason for each idea left out. Leagues are out, because My level, Over par and Rivals already give every level a winnable race. Live class mode and paper contests are out, to stay consistent with shell-me.md, and Call your score is out, to stay consistent with practice.md. The modelled score band is out, because it would be a second score model beside the one estimate. Duels and racing hidden rows are out too (the second because R12 gives hidden rows no menu). Nothing contradicts v2-decisions.md, and I committed nothing.
